Game Overview

Limited Defense is a strategy game built around command bandits and archers in a strategic battle against relentless foes in Limited Defense. Upgrade your towers and deploy legendary warriors to face mischievous slimes and fearsome orcs. Master upgrading and positioning tactics to triumph over towering bosses in this fast-paced, intense tower defense challenge.

How to Play

Limited Defense keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge. Command bandits and archers in a strategic battle against relentless foes in Limited Defense. Upgrade your towers and deploy legendary warriors to face mischievous slimes and fearsome orcs. Master upgrading and positioning tactics to triumph over towering bosses in this fast-paced, intense tower defense challenge.
